question: In which fun game do you hide from your friends? 🙈
explanation: Awesome! In Hide and Seek, one person counts while everyone else finds a secret place to hide! 🙈
hint: The name of the game tells you what to do.

question: What word do players repeat without stopping in Kabaddi? 🏃
explanation: Great job! Players chant 'Kabaddi Kabaddi' to show they are holding their breath while playing! 🏃
hint: It is the name of the game.

question: In which game do you touch a friend's back and shout 'Kho'? 🏃‍♀️
explanation: Super! In Kho-Kho, you tap your teammate's back and shout 'Kho' to make them run! 🏃‍♀️
hint: The word you shout is the name of the game.

question: What do we use to draw jumping boxes for Hopscotch? 🖍️
explanation: Fantastic! We use colorful chalk to draw the jumping boxes on the ground for Hopscotch! 🖍️
hint: It is used on blackboards too.

question: Which fun traditional toy spins round and round? 🌀
explanation: Brilliant! A Lattu is a wooden toy that dances and spins very fast on the ground! 🌀
hint: It is also known as a spinning top.

question: How many flat stones do we stack in the game of Pitthu? 🪨
explanation: Excellent! In Pitthu, players carefully stack seven flat stones on top of each other! 🪨
hint: It is the number after six.

question: What object do two teams pull in Tug of War? 🪢
explanation: Awesome! Teams use their strength to pull a thick rope across the line in Tug of War! 🪢
hint: It is very long and strong.

question: What is tied over a player's eyes in Blindman's Buff? 🧣
explanation: Great job! A cloth blindfold covers the eyes so the 'it' player has to use their ears to find friends! 🧣
hint: It covers your eyes so you cannot see.

question: What are the small, round glass balls used in Kancha called? 🔮
explanation: Super! Marbles, or Kancha, are beautiful little glass balls that players flick with their fingers! 🔮
hint: They are shiny and made of glass.

question: In Gilli Danda, what do we use to hit the small wooden piece? 🏏
explanation: Fantastic! You use a big stick (Danda) to hit the smaller peg (Gilli) up into the air! 🏏
hint: It is a long piece of wood.

question: What must you hold tightly while running in Kabaddi? 🫁
explanation: Brilliant! You must hold your breath and chant 'Kabaddi' while visiting the other team's side! 🫁
hint: It is how you take air into your lungs.

question: How do players sit on the ground at the start of Kho-Kho? 🧍‍♂️
explanation: Excellent! The chasing team sits perfectly in a straight row facing opposite ways! 🧍‍♂️
hint: Like a straight line.

question: What body part do you hop on while playing Hopscotch? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! Hopping on one leg inside the chalk boxes is the fun challenge of Hopscotch! 🦵
hint: You have two of these, but only use one to hop.

question: What do you wrap around a Lattu (Top) to make it spin? 🧵
explanation: Great job! Pulling the long string quickly makes the beautiful Lattu spin super fast! 🧵
hint: It is like a strong thread.

question: Playing together with friends helps us learn what? 🤝
explanation: Super! Team games teach us how to help each other, share, and show good teamwork! 🤝
hint: Working together to win.

question: In the game Pakdam Pakdai, what do you need to do to win? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Fantastic! Running very fast helps you catch your friends or run away from being tagged! 🏃‍♂️
hint: Moving your legs quickly.

question: What should the seeker do while counting numbers in Hide and Seek? 😌
explanation: Brilliant! The seeker must close their eyes so they do not peek while friends are hiding! 😌
hint: Making sure you cannot see anything.

question: What divides the two playing sides in a Kabaddi match? ➖
explanation: Excellent! A middle line on the ground separates the two teams during the exciting game! ➖
hint: It is drawn right in the center.

question: In Kho-Kho, players sitting in a row look in which direction? ⬅️➡️
explanation: Awesome! Sitting facing opposite directions helps the team see the runners on both sides! ⬅️➡️
hint: One looks left, the other looks right.

question: What do players throw to knock down the stones in Pitthu? 🥎
explanation: Great job! A small soft ball is thrown to hit and scatter the stack of stones safely! 🥎
hint: It is round and bouncy.

question: Tug of War is a game that tests what? 💪
explanation: Super! Pulling the heavy rope together tests how strong the whole team is when united! 💪
hint: Having lots of muscles and power.

question: How do you find your hidden friends in Blindman's Buff? ✋
explanation: Fantastic! Since your eyes are covered, you have to use your hands to carefully touch and find friends! ✋
hint: Using your hands.

question: What outside force helps a colorful kite fly high in the sky? 🌬️
explanation: Brilliant! The invisible wind catches the kite and lifts it up into the bright blue sky! 🌬️
hint: It blows through the trees.

question: What shape are the glass marbles used in Kancha? 🔴
explanation: Excellent! Marbles are perfectly round, which makes them roll smoothly on the ground! 🔴
hint: They look like tiny circles or globes.

question: Playing fun outdoor games makes our body become what? 💪
explanation: Awesome! Running, jumping, and playing outside makes your muscles and bones very strong! 💪
hint: Full of power and energy.

question: What is the best and safest place to play running games? 🏞️
explanation: Great job! A big open playground is the safest and most fun place to play outdoor games! 🏞️
hint: A park with lots of open space.

question: If your friend falls down while playing, what should you do? 🤝
explanation: Super! Good players are always kind and help their friends up if they trip or fall! 🤝
hint: Give them a hand.

question: Why do we follow special rules in every game? ⚖️
explanation: Fantastic! Rules keep everyone safe and make sure the game is fair and fun for all! ⚖️
hint: So no one cheats.

question: What is the best thing to do if you lose a friendly game? 👏
explanation: Brilliant! Smiling and clapping for the winners shows that you are a great and happy player! 👏
hint: Showing good sportsmanship.

question: When is a great time to play outdoor games with friends? 🌇
explanation: Excellent! A bright, cool evening is the perfect time to enjoy games in the fresh air! 🌇
hint: Before the sun goes down completely.

question: In Kabaddi, what do you try to touch to safely return to your side? 〰️
explanation: Awesome! Touching the center line means you are safe and can go back to your team! 〰️
hint: The mark in the middle of the field.

question: What do we do to the small peg 'Gilli' in Gilli Danda? 🏏
explanation: Great job! You flip the small Gilli in the air and then hit it as far as you can! 🏏
hint: Strike it with the big stick.

question: What object is thrown into the boxes in Hopscotch (Stapoo)? 🪨
explanation: Super! Players toss a small, flat stone or marker into the chalk box before jumping! 🪨
hint: A tiny piece of rock.

question: After hitting the stones in Pitthu, what does the team do? 🏃‍♀️
explanation: Fantastic! The team runs away to dodge the ball while trying to restack the stones! 🏃‍♀️
hint: Move fast to escape.

question: In Tug of War, when does a team lose the game? ❌
explanation: Brilliant! If a team is pulled and they cross the middle line, the other team wins! ❌
hint: Going over the mark.

question: What sense helps you find friends when blindfolded? 👂
explanation: Excellent! Listening closely for giggles and footsteps helps you catch players in Blindman's Buff! 👂
hint: Using your ears.

question: What makes team games so much fun to play? 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Awesome! Enjoying the game with friends and laughing together makes playing so much fun! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
hint: Joining your friends.

question: What comes out on our skin to cool us down when we play hard? 💦
explanation: Great job! Sweating is completely normal and helps keep your amazing body cool while playing! 💦
hint: Little water drops on your forehead.

question: What do you happily shout when you find someone hiding? 😃
explanation: Super! Shouting 'I found you!' lets everyone know the hidden player has been spotted! 😃
hint: A happy cheer for discovering them.

question: In Pakdam Pakdai, what happens if the chaser touches you? 👉
explanation: Fantastic! If tagged, you become the new chaser and get to run after everyone else! 👉
hint: It is your turn to catch.

question: What part of a flying kite do we hold tightly in our hands? 🧵
explanation: Brilliant! We hold the spool of thread (Manjha) to control the beautiful kite in the sky! 🧵
hint: The string that keeps it attached to you.

question: What makes a traditional Top (Lattu) look like it is dancing? 🌀
explanation: Excellent! Because it spins so fast on its tiny point, it looks like a magical dancer! 🌀
hint: Turning around quickly.

question: What must we drink to stay healthy after playing outside? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Drinking fresh water after sweating keeps your body super strong and perfectly hydrated! 💧
hint: A clear, healthy drink.

question: Kho-Kho is an amazing game all about what action? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Great job! Kho-Kho is a thrilling game where you chase players as fast as you can! 🏃‍♂️
hint: Running after someone.

question: What must you not do while raiding in the opposite team's side in Kabaddi? 😮‍💨
explanation: Super! You must keep saying 'Kabaddi' in one single breath until you are back safe! 😮‍💨
hint: Letting the air go.

question: Which game is played with a big stick and a tiny wooden peg? 🏏
explanation: Fantastic! Gilli Danda is an exciting outdoor game played with two wooden pieces! 🏏
hint: The name has two words starting with G and D.

question: Hopping on one leg in Hopscotch helps us improve what? ⚖️
explanation: Brilliant! Jumping and standing on one leg trains our body to have amazing balance! ⚖️
hint: Not falling over.

question: What hard material are Kancha (Marbles) made of? 🔮
explanation: Excellent! Traditional marbles are beautiful little spheres made of solid, colorful glass! 🔮
hint: A clear, breakable material.

question: How do we usually feel after playing fun traditional games? 😄
explanation: Awesome! Playing games outside releases good energy and leaves us feeling incredibly happy! 😄
hint: Smiling big smiles.

question: What do local and traditional games teach us about? 🏛️
explanation: Great job! Traditional games are beautiful parts of our culture played for many generations! 🏛️
hint: Things from our past and culture.
